name: Wenxiao Zhang
title: PhD Candidate in Computer Science · AI Engineer · Data Scientist
summary: I am a PhD candidate in Computer Science at The University of Western Australia, researching reliable and secure large language model (LLM) agent systems for complex knowledge and execution tasks — spanning agentic retrieval, multi-hop reasoning, multimodal personal agents, and pre-execution safety verification for agents that act in the real world.

Alongside research, I build production AI systems. At Telstra I designed and shipped an enterprise GraphRAG and agentic retrieval platform for frontline customer service — a Neo4j knowledge graph over Salesforce data with query decomposition and multi-step planning — together with an automated RAG evaluation system delivered on Azure ML with Docker, CI/CD, and TDD. Before my PhD I worked as a software developer on CMS and enterprise transport platforms, and I tutor Cloud Computing, Intelligent Agents, Web Development, Cybersecurity, and Database Systems at UWA.
